correction.interpretation: These snapshots show the benchmark process present at point-in-time only. They do not prove that calibration timing was active at those instants. The exact calibration interval and mapping of the six journal attempts to process/load snapshots are unavailable because no per-attempt wall-clock timestamps were recorded.
correction.stage2_timing_overlap: Stage2 compilation is present in some process snapshots, including release-build overlap, but without per-attempt timestamps its overlap with measured calibration attempts is unknown. Its direct effect on calibration totals is unquantified.
